room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction on other expenses if ICU rate exceeds limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment on every admissible claim

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year (whichever lower); listed modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.) capped at 50% of SI; ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

ped_waiting.note: Table of benefits mentions 4 years (48 months) for declared PEDs; Section 6.1 states 36 months; 36 months used as per main policy wording

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, ENT disorders etc.; 36-month wait for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl 18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50%

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (Section 7.18)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in policy wording

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Consumables listed in Annexure-A List I are excluded; no optional rider available

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded (Section 7.19 and 10.7)

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary/OPD, maternity, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, cosmetic surgery, adventure sports injuries
